result.description: Compact network-attached archive appliance designed for quiet long-term document retention in home studios and small offices. Includes dual Gigabit Ethernet, scheduled backup mirroring, and a browser-based management console. Optimized for cold storage, with a low-power embedded controller, RAID 1 support, and file sharing over SMB and FTP.
result.title: Vela Arbor 6TB Network Archive Appliance
